TO: All staff, OYO Company
FROM: Rachel Rand, Security Operations Manager, OYO Company
DATE: April 5
SUBJECT: Notice for Change to Security Procedures

This is a notice that as of TODAY all elevators will have restricted access via a security code. As a reminder, the company does not permit "pranks" on company property, and "it’s April Fools’" is not recognized by the HR department as an extenuating circumstance. Remember that these incidents can endanger other employees, or worse, jeopardize our profit margin.

To ensure all employees recognize the severity of these incidents, the elevator code will serve as a cautionary memorial.
